size_pct_nav: Approximately 40% of partnership at the later concentration checkpoint; about $13 million, not an initial-February allocation

drivers.driver: The fiscal injury did not destroy the exceptional economics of the payments franchise.
drivers.quote: Both were one-of-a-kind companies, temporarily reeling from the effects of a fiscal blow that did not destroy their exceptional underlying economics.

drivers.driver: Continued customer use of cheques and cards supported treating the franchise separately from warehousing claims.
drivers.source: Lowenstein, Buffett: The Making of an American Capitalist, American Express episode (1995; hindsight explanation)

drivers.driver: A large market-value decline created a business-value opportunity rather than a need for a market forecast.
Management's willingness to protect the name mattered because trust underpinned the operating franchise.
drivers.source: Schroeder, The Snowball, American Express episode (chapter reference not recovered) (2008; hindsight explanation)
